usage: The word '膠' (gaau1) can be used to refer to plastic as a material.
It can also mean glue, especially in casual contexts.
In everyday conversation, '膠' is often used to talk about things made from plastic.
While primarily a noun, '膠' can sometimes describe something fake or silly in slang, but here we focus on material.
Remember to check context to distinguish between plastic material and glue meaning.
